skills.description: Transfer memory files from one OpenClaw agent to another. Use when you need to migrate memory, configuration, or context from one agent to another agent.
skills.description_zh: 在OpenClaw代理间传输记忆文件。适用于需在代理间迁移记忆、配置或上下文时。
skills.name: Memory Transfer
